julian (brightlane): Hey support — finished the onboarding flow for Brightlane but our service key isn't showing under the project in the console. We only see an org-level orphaned credential. Deploy is blocked :grimacing:
sophie (support): Sorry about that. Can you paste org_id and project_id? Also did you use SSO/OIDC or manual invite?
julian (brightlane): org_id: org-9b2a, project_id: proj-7c11. We used OIDC SSO via Okta.
sophie (support): Thanks. Can you confirm the key id you received in the email? (the one starting with ak_...)
julian (brightlane): Key from email: ak_3f2d9c. It works when I curl the API for inference but the console doesn't show it under the project.
mike (platform): :eyes: assigning to infra. Sophie — can you run a quick lookup in provisioning logs? I'll check the key metadata.
sophie (support): On it. running: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' https://provisioner.redwood.ai/v1/keys/ak_3f2d9c`
onboard-bot: provisioner: key ak_3f2d9c created at 2024-11-23T14:02:05Z, status=active, metadata={scope:service, created_by:svc-onboard, project_id: }
mike (platform): Aha — project_id tag is empty. The key exists but never got the project binding tag. Likely a sync race between claim worker and indexer. Creating ticket INC-4321.
sophie (support): Quick workaround: run admin command to bind key to project. `rwictl keys bind --key ak_3f2d9c --project proj-7c11` If you can't run, we can bind it for you temporarily. Would you like us to proceed?
julian (brightlane): Please bind it for us — we can't access rwictl. Thanks.
mike (platform): Done — bound key and forced reindex. After binding console shows it under proj-7c11. Please verify.
julian (brightlane): Confirmed, key shows up in console and deploys. Thanks! Any idea why it happened?
mike (platform): Root cause: onboarding service created key before claim binding propagated to claims-db due to transient 503 from claims service. We added retry logic and a post-create validation. Also added alert if key metadata is missing project_id. Ticket INC-4321 has details: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4321
alex (solutions): Noted — I'll follow up with Brightlane with an explanation and the workaround steps for future onboarding. :white_check_mark:
sophie (support): Closing the loop — marking as resolved in support. If you see anything else ping me. :party_parrot:
